title: Delivery Profile Configuration
description: The `delivery:` block of atdd-bun.yaml: which models may author and review each lifecycle stage, in preference order, how independent a reviewer must be, and when a model counts as unavailable. Every key is optional; an omitted key takes the package default (src/delivery.ts). `stages`, when given, replaces the default stage set: a stage it omits is not required.
$comment: Shipped by the delivery profile (delivery_evidence). Cross-field checks (a reviewer listed twice, a stage override naming an unknown mode) are schema-level; loosening against the base branch is judged by the integrity check.

root.description: Repository-relative folder holding one <tranche>/evidence.yaml per tranche, in canonical form: no leading, trailing or doubled slash, no dot segments. Default: docs/delivery/tranches, beside the program's reasoning in the docs profile's delivery area. Changing it after adoption is a loosening the integrity check reports.

require_record.description: At the gate, a change outside the delivery root needs a tranche record in the same change, unless atdd-bun.yaml is the only such file. Default: true; turning it off is a loosening.

multiplexer.description: The terminal multiplexer the coordinator drives agents through, named by its command. Default: herdr. Any other name is accepted; the agent learns its commands from the multiplexer's own help.

board.description: The local message board agents talk through (delivery.board). $ATDD_BOARD_URL overrides it on a machine that runs the board elsewhere.

url.description: A local address only. Default: http://127.0.0.1:2586.

after_failures.description: Failures (outage, rate limit, no auditable report) before a model counts as unavailable. A REQUEST CHANGES verdict is never a failure.

when_exhausted.description: block: the tranche emits BLOCKED provider-unavailable and the coordinator reassigns the slot. wait: the driver keeps retrying the last model in the list.

commands.description: Headless invocation per model, overriding the skill's built-in defaults. {prompt} and {worktree} are substituted by the driver. Adding or changing an entry after adoption is a loosening the integrity check reports; removing one returns to the default.

independence.description: fresh-process: the reviewer is a new process that wrote nothing in the tranche. different-model (the default): additionally, its model wrote none of the work the review covers.

models.description: Models in preference order: the first is used normally, each later one only as a recorded fallback.

writer.description: Who may write this stage, in preference order. Absent: nobody writes it, as for final.

reviewer.description: Who reviews this stage, in preference order. Absent: the stage is held by its gate alone.

authors.description: 0.9 spelling of writer, on a 0.9 stage name.

reviewers.description: 0.9 spelling of reviewer, on a 0.9 stage name.
